methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly and called with mock copy_from_env. Four scenarios tested: (1) do-nothing — copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError → score=0, passed=False; (2) wrong-target — result JSON has minimal/wrong content → passed=False; (3) partial — some criteria met, threshold not reached → passed=False; (4) full — all criteria met → score>=60, passed=True. No Windows VM required.
